subject: Exec workshop travel — connection buffer & split-ticket updates
messages:
From: Acme Travel Concierge <acme-travel@acmecorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec workshop travel — connection buffer for tight PNRs

Hi Stephanie,

Following up on the three requested itineraries for the June 24–25 onsite in Denver. We ran into a constraint on carrier availability for Karthik's preferred routing (SFO→DEN with a single connection); the only nonstop+one-stop combos leave a 35–40 minute connection at IAH which is risky given his on-call responsibilities.

Options we can pursue:
- Split-ticket Karthik: SFO→IAH (AA) + separate IAH→DEN (UA) with a 2h+ buffer — slightly higher cost but minimal rebooking risk.
- Re-route via LAX for a longer connection (same carrier) but adds ~1h ground time.
- Hold inventory and ticket all on the same PNR with a forced 2h layover (may push earlier departure).

I've tentatively priced split-ticket vs same-PNR and attached a quick cost comparison. Also flagged ground transfer timing in case arrivals are split across carriers.

Attachment stubs: cost_compare_split_vs_single.pdf (summary), initial_options.csv (raw fares)

Let me know which approach you want us to lock for Karthik; we can proceed to ticketing for Marcus and the third attendee once we have your go-ahead.

Thanks,
Maya Alvarez
Senior Planner — Acme Travel Concierge
acme-travel@acmecorp.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Acme Travel Concierge <acme-travel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop travel — connection buffer for tight PNRs

Thanks, Maya — appreciate the options. A couple quick priorities from our side:

1) For Karthik: please do the split-ticket approach to guarantee a minimum 2h connection buffer. He will not accept a <60 minute connection. If split increases cost, charge to the corporate travel card (Concur req coming).
2) For Marcus: keep him on a same-PNR routing if possible — prefer fewer legs.
3) Ground transfer: please provide an ETA-based transfer option in the quote (we prefer a single vendor shuttle if arrivals are within 45 minutes).

Monica, looping you in to coordinate the Concur payment flow and ground vendor selection.

If you can send concrete PNR proposals with seat maps by EOD tomorrow (6/2), we can confirm.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Growth Ops | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0147
From: Acme Travel Concierge <acme-travel@acmecorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop travel — connection buffer for tight PNRs

Stephanie — thanks for the direction. Sending two concrete options below (details abridged). Full fare rules + seat maps attached.

Option A (recommended for Karthik — split-ticket)
- Leg 1: SFO → IAH (AA 873) depart 06/24 06:00, arrive 06/24 12:20 local
- Leg 2: IAH → DEN (UA 421) depart 06/24 14:45, arrive 06/24 16:50 local
- Total transit buffer: 2h25m
- Price delta vs same-PNR: +$210
- Attachment: PNR_KI_4621_proposal.pdf

Option B (Marcus — same PNR)
- Nonstop SFO → DEN (DL 620) depart 06/24 07:35, arrive 06/24 13:05 local
- Seat map attached (preferred exit row available)
- Attachment: PNR_ML_4622_proposal.pdf

Ground: preliminary shuttle provider estimate attached (ground_transfer_estimate.pdf). Vendor can guarantee a 15–20 minute wait window for single-car arrivals, or we can reserve a minivan for split arrivals (additional $95).

If this looks good I'll proceed to ticketing and send final PNRs and e-tickets.

Attachments: PNR_KI_4621_proposal.pdf, PNR_ML_4622_proposal.pdf, ground_transfer_estimate.pdf

Best,
Maya Alvarez
Acme Travel Concierge
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Acme Travel Concierge <acme-travel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop travel — connection buffer for tight PNRs

Thanks — split-ticket option A is fine with me. Please select an aisle in economy plus if available; otherwise regular aisle is fine. Charge to the corporate card.

Also protip: if there is an opportunity to route via SJC instead of SFO (shorter TSA lines the morning of), I'm open — but only if connection buffer stays >=2h.

-Karthik
From: Acme Travel Concierge <acme-travel@acmecorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Subject: Finalized: PNRs & shuttle — TerraLabs exec workshop (June 24–25)

All — booking complete per instructions. Final e-tickets and PNR stubs attached. Summary below:

- Karthik Iyer (split-ticket) — PNR_KI_4621.pdf attached
  • SFO→IAH (AA 873) 06/24 06:00–12:20 (seat: 12C, aisle, EconPlus)
  • IAH→DEN (UA 421) 06/24 14:45–16:50 (seat: 22A, aisle)

- Marcus Lin (same-PNR) — PNR_ML_4622.pdf attached
  • DL 620 nonstop SFO→DEN 06/24 07:35–13:05 (seat: 18A, aisle)

- Ground transfer: reserved with Summit Shuttles — van reserved for split arrival policy, pickup at DEN arrivals zone C. See ground_transfer_estimate.pdf (invoice stub).

Notes: Concur charge initiated under REQ-99872; Monica, you'll see an authorization pending for the fares + shuttle. If any seat change is required, respond within 24 hours to avoid fare penalties.

Attachments (final): PNR_KI_4621.pdf, PNR_ML_4622.pdf, ground_transfer_estimate.pdf

Safe travels — we will monitor on day-of and alert for any irregular operations.

Cheers,
